title: BLOODSTAIN EULOGIES
description: Player death marks now preserve the final build, last mistake, and one tiny epitaph that other wanderers can read before deciding whether to repeat the tragedy.
consequence: The bloodstain gets candles and a comment section.

title: SECRET ENDING LOCKBOX
description: Rare endings now hide their final room, boss title, and reward art from previews and share cards until the player reaches them personally.
consequence: The finale shuts the theater doors.

title: VIRAL GRAVE EMOTES
description: Squad wipes now trigger branded death poses, animated farewell stickers, and auto-framed defeat cards sized perfectly for every social feed that still has shame left.

title: CANON-SAFE LEGEND FILTER
description: Player legends now replace custom names, strange choices, and embarrassing heroic accidents with approved archetype labels before any recap leaves the game.
